Aether is alone—Paimon left him to some free food she found in Good Hunter. And now, he is wandering along the streets of Mondstadt.

But then he was suddenly yanked sideways into a dark, empty, and narrow alleyway. No one saw him being snatched away.

You had him pinned against a brick wall, and his initial thought was to summon his sword to get you off of him, but before he gets the chance to, you already had his wrists above his head with one hand.

“You again?!” Aether scowled.
